pages.ja:
……戦いは続いている。
セイバーは俺を守る為に戦っている。
なら
何が出来なくとも、行かないと。

なら

pages.en:
…The battle is still raging.

Saber is fighting to protect me.

Then even if I cannot do a thing to help, I have to go.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…The battle continues.
Saber is fighting to protect me.
ThenI should go even if there’s nothing I can do.

pages.ja:
左手に刻まれた二つの令呪。
マスターとして戦うと誓い、セイバーと握手を交わして、俺はここに立っている。
pages.jaRuby:
左手に刻まれた二つの令呪。
マスターとして戦うと誓い、セイバーと握手を交わして、俺はここに立っている。
pages.en:
Two Command Spells remain etched into my left hand.

I swore I would fight as a Master, and Saber and I sealed it with a handshake. That is why I am standing here.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The two Command Spells engraved on my hand…
I am standing here after swearing to fight as a Master and shaking hands with Saber.

pages.ja:
「ああもう
なにやってんだ俺は……！」
迷いと恐れを断ち切って走り出す。
二人の後を追えば殺される。
震える背中を見栄とか意地とかで押さえつけて、全力で坂道を駆け上がった。
pages.jaRuby:
「ああもう
なにやってんだ俺は……！」
迷いと恐れを断ち切って走り出す。
二人の後を追えば殺される。
震える背中を見栄とか意地とかで押さえつけて、全力で坂道を駆け上がった。
pages.en:
“Dammit—what the hell am I doing…!?”

I cut through my fear and indecision and run.

—If I follow them, I will be killed.

I force my trembling back straight with pride, stubbornness—anything that will hold it—and sprint up the hill with all I have.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“GeezWhat am I doing…!?”
I run, ignoring all hesitation and fear.
I’ll be killed if I go after them.
I suppress my trembling body with force and obstinacy, and I run up the hill.

pages.ja:
「下がって衛宮くん。それ以上前に出るとセイバーの邪魔になるわ」
肩を掴まれて足を止める。
pages.jaRuby:
「下がって衛宮くん。それ以上前に出るとセイバーの邪魔になるわ」

pages.en:
“Stay back, Emiya. Go any farther and you'll only get in Saber's way.”

A hand closes on my shoulder and brings me to a halt.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Get back, Emiya-kun. You’ll get in Saber’s way if you go any farther.”
I stop as she grabs my shoulder.

pages.ja:
「聞こえなかった？ このままならセイバーが勝つから、大人しく観戦してなさいって言ったの。……ま、そんなのわたしが言わなくても読み取れると思うけど」
木の陰に隠れていたのか、遠坂は落ち着いた声で俺を呼び止める。
pages.jaRuby:
「聞こえなかった？ このままならセイバーが勝つから、大人しく観戦してなさいって言ったの。……ま、そんなのわたしが言わなくても読み取れると思うけど」
木の陰に隠れていたのか、遠坂は落ち着いた声で俺を呼び止める。
pages.en:
“Didn't you hear me? I said Saber will win if this keeps up, so be quiet and watch. …Though I would have thought you could tell that without my having to say it.”

She must have been hiding behind a tree. Tohsaka calls me back in a perfectly composed voice.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Did you hear me? I told you that you should keep quiet and watch since Saber’s going to win. …Well, I think you can tell that yourself though.”
She must have been hiding behind a tree, as she calls out to me with a calm voice.

pages.ja:
「え……セイバーが、勝つ……？」
あの怪物に？
さっきまで戦いにさえならなかったあの巨人相手に、セイバーが勝つっていうのか……！？
pages.jaRuby:
「え……セイバーが、勝つ……？」
あの怪物に？
さっきまで戦いにさえならなかったあの巨人相手に、セイバーが勝つっていうのか……！？
pages.en:
“What…? Saber is going to win…?”

Against that monster?

Saber is going to beat the same giant she could not even fight a moment ago…!?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Huh? Saber will win…?”
Against that monster?
Saber will win against that giant she couldn’t even match until now?

pages.ja:
「ふん、信じられないって顔ね。
……いいから良く見たら？ こんなコト言いたくないけど、貴方のサーヴァントは心技共に最高よ。このまま邪魔が入らなければ、セイバーはバーサーカーを撃退するわ」
ふん、と鼻を鳴らして木の陰に潜む遠坂。
pages.jaRuby:
「ふん、信じられないって顔ね。
……いいから良く見たら？ こんなコト言いたくないけど、貴方のサーヴァントは心技共に最高よ。このまま邪魔が入らなければ、セイバーはバーサーカーを撃退するわ」

pages.en:
“Hmph. I can see you don't believe me.

“…Just watch, will you? I hate to admit it, but your Servant is unsurpassed in both skill and spirit. If no one interferes, Saber will drive Berserker back.”

With a dismissive sniff, Tohsaka slips behind the tree again.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Heh. You look like you don’t believe me.
Why don’t you take a look? I don’t want to admit this, but your Servant is great in all aspects. Saber should be able to beat Berserker.”
Tohsaka snorts and hides behind the tree.

pages.ja:
交差する剣戟。
バーサーカーの一撃は悉く空を切り、台風のように周囲を破壊するだけだ。
その合間。
振るわれる旋風と舞い上がる土塊、切断されていく墓石の雨の中、セイバーは鎧さえ汚さずバーサーカーに肉薄する。
pages.jaRuby:
交差する剣戟。
バーサーカーの一撃は悉く空を切り、台風のように周囲を破壊するだけだ。
その合間。
振るわれる旋風と舞い上がる土塊、切断されていく墓石の雨の中、セイバーは鎧さえ汚さずバーサーカーに肉薄する。
pages.en:
—The blades cross.

Every one of Berserker's blows cuts empty air, doing nothing but laying waste to the ground around him like a typhoon.

And between them—through the shrieking wind, the clods of earth flung skyward, the rain of gravestones being hewn apart—Saber closes on Berserker without so much as a stain upon her armor.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Clashing swords.
Berserker’s attacks smash through empty space and only destroy his surroundings.
Between the attacks…
Within the swinging whirlwind, flying clods, and the rain of broken gravestones, Saber rushes in without even dirtying her armor and attacks Berserker.

pages.ja:
「………………………………」
これ以上はないという神業。
人の身では到底及ばない戦いを見せつけられ、先ほどまでの恐怖は消え去っていた。
いや、正直見惚れてさえいる。
pages.jaRuby:
「………………………………」

pages.en:
“………………………………”

It is skill bordering upon the divine.

Watching a battle no human body could ever approach, I find that the terror I felt before has vanished.

No—to be honest, I am spellbound.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
It is a divine work of utmost excellence.
My fear has disappeared, seeing this battle that is totally impossible for mere humans.
Instead, I am fascinated.

pages.ja:
聖杯戦争なんて言われても実感は湧かなかったし、不安もあった。
だが、そんなものは彼女を見て吹き飛んだ。
pages.jaRuby:
聖杯戦争なんて言われても実感は湧かなかったし、不安もあった。

pages.en:
The words *Holy Grail War* had never seemed real to me. I had been afraid.

But one look at her scatters every fear I had.

pages.ja:
舞い狂う剣舞。
触れれば一瞬にして肉塊にされる旋風の中、躊躇うことなく敵に挑む騎士の姿。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
A dance of blades, wild and furious.

A knight who plunges without hesitation into a whirlwind that would reduce her to raw flesh at the slightest touch.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Dancing swords.
Within the whirlwind of fatal destruction, the knight challenges the enemy without hesitation.

pages.en:
…Perhaps that sight made me accept everything.

Whatever may await me from this point onward,

so long as I stand with the girl called Saber, I can fight on—even against a demon god.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…Maybe this scene made me accept everything.
No matter what may befall us in the future…
I will be able to match even a fierce god if I have Saber with me.

Tohsaka murmurs in a voice emptied of emotion.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I thought so. It was strange, but she blocked Berserker’s sword on purpose.”
Tohsaka murmurs without emotion.

“…You mean to lure Berserker here?”

“Not bad. Fighting that thing in an open space without cover would be suicide. That’s why Saber chose this place as the battlefield. She led Berserker away from you naturally, all while pretending he had driven her into a corner.”

“…Was that to lure Berserker here?”
“Yup. It’s suicidal to fight Berserker in a place without cover. That’s why Saber chose this place as the battleground. She did it naturally, too. She got Berserker away from you, all the while she pretended to be cornered.”

“But you can’t expect backup in a battle like this.
Our enemy is a monster that even nullifies Archer’s arrows.
Backup was meaningless from the start.”
Tohsaka murmurs as she watches the battle between Saber and Berserker.

If he really is an archer, not merely one in name, then of course he would avoid close combat, but—

If he really is an archer, he should not fight hand-to-hand, but

“She got him—!”

Tohsaka snaps her fingers.

Just as she cries out, Berserker’s body—never once shaken until now—lurches off balance. Either Saber’s blade has reached him, or he has lost his footing.

Tohsaka snaps her fingers.
Just as she said… Saber’s sword must have hit Berserker, or Berserker must have lost his footing.
Berserker’s body, holding firm until now, loses its balance.

The whirlwind lashes out in desperation.

Saber evades it with a great leap backward, then settles her sword into both hands once more.

Saber dodges it by jumping back, and holds her sword with both hands.

—That will decide it.

His desperate blow evaded, Berserker loses his balance still further.

Saber bends her knees, ready to drive forward with every ounce of strength she has.

This is it.
As his desperate attack was dodged, Berserker loses his balance even more,
and Saber bends her knees to charge in with all her power.
